text: Meet Referral Easy, a simpler way to coordinate specialist referrals.
Referrals can mean chasing coverage, paperwork, and appointments. Here, you open your referral, compare providers, choose a time, and approve.
Seven agents work together behind the scenes. Coverage and provider matching run in parallel, while the gateway enforces permissions.
Your approval covers the exact request. If a booking response is lost, we check the same request key to prevent duplicates.
After a restart, Postgres restores progress. Expired workers can't overwrite newer decisions.
When a document is missing or a slot disappears, you get a clear next step. Human handoff includes your summary and permission.
Open Telemetry connects every step. Referral Easy. A simpler experience, with control built in.
